dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Yep! The scenery is soooo different from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: I even caught a fish! Fish skin is slippery, so they're super hard to catch... Well, harder than catching crabs anyway. That's what Jill does.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: But anyway, I don't have a bowl to put this fish in. So why don't you take it?
